statements.text: When ASML trades at its all-time high on rising volume, the price rose in 90 % of 10 independent cases within 8 trading days.
When ASML trades at its all-time high on falling volume, the price fell in 85 % of 13 independent cases within 8 trading days.
When ASML trades at its all-time high in the middle of a breakout on rising volume, the price rose in 78 % of 9 independent cases within 2 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, ASML came back every time: in all 4 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 24 months at most.
After a fall of 30 % from its all-time high, ASML came back every time: in all 4 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 23 months at most.
